translations.web: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.
translations.bsb: “Therefore behold,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who steal from one another words they attribute to Me.”
translations.kjv: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
translations.asv: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith Jehovah, that steal my words every one from his neighbor.
